generated_from: Current question bank; field completeness and answer-letter comparison are recorded separately from source-level visual verification.

answer_key_audit.source: Official GSET final answer-key PDFs for November 2023, December 2024, and November 2025, Music Paper-II
answer_key_audit.note: Stored answer and official_answer fields were compared question-by-question against the parsed official final-key PDF text for all 100 questions in each of the three papers. This only verifies answer-letter agreement with the key; it does not verify question wording, option order, or whether the key transcription itself was OCR-perfect.

remaining_gates: Visually proofread all 300 English and Gujarati stems/options and option order against the original official question-paper PDFs.
Inspect diagrams, musical notation, symbols, and tables against the original source-page images.
Manually validate all 300 syllabus-unit mappings against the official syllabus, including stream-specific Hindustani, Karnataka/Carnatic, percussion, and Rabindra Sangeet content.
Reconcile stored answer letters directly against official final answer-key PDF pages and record any discrepancies.
Run Music-specific validation and full app build/CI on the current PR head before merge.

visual_audit_progress.note: No question is counted as visually proofread unless its English/Gujarati stem, all four options and order, and any figures/notation have been compared with the original official paper page. Existing OCR and field-completeness counts are not visual proof.
